dialog.conceptHandle: empty by default, user-required, max 80 characters

writes.cancel: no MemOS write and no local mint
writes.draftFailure: retry only; no confirmation and no local mint
writes.writeFailure: dialog retained for retry; no favorite/verdictId
writes.successOrExisting: favorite=true and verdictId stored after MemOS result
writes.repeat: same chain tail returned without another write

tests.webUi: e2e/papertable.spec.ts: web adopts a completed turn only after explicit gold confirmation
